caseNameFull: California v. Southland Royalty Co. El Paso Natural Gas Co. v. Southland Royalty Co. and Federal Energy Regulatory Commission v. Southland Royalty Co.

opinions.text:
436 U. S. 519. Motion of Natural Gas Producing Industry Assns. et al., for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of respondents not to recuse Mr. Justice Stewart and Mr. Justice Powell denied. Motion of Crane County Development Co. for leave to file petition for rehearing denied. Petition for rehearing denied.

Mr. Justice Stewart and Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions and petition.
